newsitem.title: LEBANON: Dollar well offered on Beirut forex market.
newsitem.headline: Dollar well offered on Beirut forex market.

text.p: The dollar was well offered on the Beirut foreign exchange market in the week ending on Friday with trading restricted to a very narrow band at the bottom of the central bank's intervention band, dealers said.
The Bank of Lebanon continued its steady reduction of the intervention rate, lowering its offer rate by one Lebanese pound to 1,546.5-1,556 from last Friday's 1,546.5-1,557.
"Trading was at the bid side of the central bank's intervention rate with dollars offered at as little as five or 10 piastres above it," a dealer told Reuters.
He said that in terms of percentages the bid-offer spread on the interbank market was one of the lowest in the world.

The dollar supply to the market came from normal commercial requirements as well as from foreign interest in the local treasury bill market in the New Year, the dealer added. -- Beirut newsroom (961 1) 602057 345740 345723
